note: Lab clip 16, Linden Row (26 Nov): a 20 s test of a new style for HQ and the user, flat paper characters in a lit 3D street, one travelling shot. The opening of an original story with a root-cause angle; the mole guy is the suspect. The narrator only (af_heart, 1.0). Each line is its own entry so the pauses are set by hand.
ref_text: The bench outside the stall is warm from the afternoon. A kettle hisses, a cyclist rings his bell, and somebody laughs at the next table.

lines.text: Every night on Linden Row, something vanishes.
A bike. A kettle. A dog's ball.
Every morning, it's back on a doorstep, washed.
The street blames the new man at number nine.
He has a mole, and a past.
But he moved in the same week as something else.
